			{
				int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Output.CVSTAT", "child_count"));
				int? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Output.CVSTATDS", "child_count"));

				{
					AdvComboVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					Grid1Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					Grid2Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else if (!num2.HasValue || num2.Value == 0)
				{
					AdvComboVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					Grid1Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					Grid2Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}

					RefreshGrids();
				}
			}

			}
		}

		{

				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "advcbo2_AdvCollection.SelectedItem"));

				{
					Grid1Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					Grid2Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				else if (text == "Design Spec / Tear Variable" || text == Resources.MMNewton_Result_Summar_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Design_Spec___Tear_Variable)
				{
					Grid1Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					Grid2Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
		}
